findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
The owner’s CFM certification is expired, this has been a repeat violation in the past.  She has been given information for the CFM classes held at SCDPH and is planning on signing up for the March class.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Kitchen hand sink and the restroom hand sinks need to be re-caulked.  The caulk present is cracked and wearing away, allowing moisture to become trapped between the hand sink and wall.  Ensure sinks are re-caulked to provide an easily cleanable and smooth surface.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Baffles were observed to contain an accumulation of dust and grease debris.  Non-food contact surfaces shall be kept clean to prevent food contamination.  Ensure baffles are cleaned in between professional cleaning scheduling.

(C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Employee blocked hand sink with bus tub after inspector had advised once to ensure hand sink is not blocked/remains accessible for handwashing. Bus tub removed from handsink. Education provided.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10).

Chlorine bleach concentration in 3rd sink compartment sink registered at 0ppm on test strips. COS-education provided. Ensure enough bleach is added, per manufacturers instructions to create a concentration of 100ppm for sanitizing step.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-703.11: Observed staff member place bleach in both 2nd and 3rd compartment of the ware washing sink. COS- education provided. Warewashing in a commercial setting is a 3-step process: wash, rinse, and sanitize. Ensure wares are washed with soap in sink 1, rinsed in sink 2, and then submerged in sanitizer solution in sink 3 in accordance with label directions for bleach,

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Gallon of milk observed with no date label. Inspector discussed with PIC labeling requirements for QBC under FDA food code. 
Also stores personal food in some of the fridges, discussed that items for personal/family use should be designated as such and inspector will not look for datemarking on those items.
